parsed.name: 混合信号示波器
parsed.description: 这是一类台式混合信号示波器，用于采集和显示电压波形，并测量频率、相位等时域参数。它常用于电子实验与调试中观察模拟或数字信号、设置触发条件、调整时基与垂直量程，以及保存波形数据和屏幕截图。
parsed.description_en: This is a bench-top mixed-signal oscilloscope used to acquire and display voltage waveforms and to measure time-domain parameters such as frequency and phase. It is commonly used in electronics labs for observing analog or digital signals, setting trigger conditions, adjusting timebase and vertical scale, and saving waveform data or screen captures.
